$comment: SM030 O3: replaces platform_evidence_standard (deprecated, kept for history). One row per obligation - the flat shelf-fact projection of one instrument's obligations/*.yaml entry (obligation.schema.json / instrument.schema.json), plus the engine-routing fields (`dispute_type`, `kind`, `register`, `register_match`, `measure`, `anchor`) a verdict recompute needs to evaluate it against a project's own registers. Those six are NOT published in the obligations/ tree: they are Demiton's own wiring for which register feeds which check, not part of what the obligation is (GOVERNANCE.md's public/private line). Field names below deliberately match the retiring platform_evidence_standard contract where the concept is the same (`standard_key`, `source_title`, `source_clause`, `source_url`, `dispute_type`) so the verdict engine that reads this shelf changes its data source, not its field access. Every field the projection writes is declared here: a consumer that compares a stored row with a new one through this contract ignores an undeclared key present on one side only, so an undeclared field never reaches a row already stored.

instrument_id.description: the instrument this obligation belongs to, e.g. `bif_act_2017_qld`

source.description: which of the seven sources the instrument belongs to

consequence.description: what missing the duty costs, as the source states it

protection_type.description: the engine that runs this obligation once switched on

disease.description: which of the five diseases this obligation guards against

approval_class.description: what kind of sign-off this obligation's evidence needs: the obligation's `approval_class`, a member of vocab/approval_classes.json

grade.description: how close to the primary source the reading was

source_url.description: the primary source for this exact duty

citation_access_date.description: when the primary source was read

evidence_kind.description: how this obligation is evidenced once switched on

evidence_system_type.description: for evidence_kind=register only: the system type that would fill it

jurisdiction.description: where this obligation applies: the ISO 3166-1/3166-2 code

applies_to_form.description: the contract form this obligation is written for; `statute` for a legislative rule, `any` when form-independent

dispute_type.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: which of the five SM026 dispute-type buckets this obligation was transcribed from - a narrower, internal taxonomy the anchor map is keyed on, distinct from `disease`

kind.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: how the duty is measured against a project's registers - a cadence (`periodic`), a window after an anchor event (`event_bound`), a retention period (`retention`) or a standing condition (`state`)

measure.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: the computation that judges this row, `kind` unless a named strategy overrides it

register.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: the tenant register this obligation is evaluated against

register_match.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: equality predicate on `register` selecting the evidence

anchor.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: for an `event_bound` row, the event its window runs from (`register`, `date_field`, `target_date_field`)

trigger.description: the event that starts this obligation's clock: the obligation's `trigger`, a key of vocab/event_types.json. Empty when the window is not anchored to an event

trigger_event.description: the `trigger`'s entry in vocab/event_types.json, resolved beside it: register, date field, subject, and the match, requires_item and reference fields that say which records count

window_value.description: the cadence or window length in `window_unit`

window_source_field.description: the `contract_terms` field whose value overrides `window_value` when the contract states its own window (SM030 decision 5: strictest wins)

threshold_direction.description: for a `threshold` obligation: `max` (a ceiling) or `min` (a floor), the side of the line that is strict

threshold_value.description: for a `threshold` obligation: the limit, or the labelled default when `threshold_set_by` is `org`

threshold_set_by.description: `library` (the limit is the instrument's) or `org` (the contractor sets its own at switch-on, and it is never published)

research_row.description: the row id in Demiton's own research record this obligation was transcribed from

title: platform_obligation contract v1
